City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, APRIL 15, 2015 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.

3.

4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation by Mira Costa Superintendent/President Dr. Sunny Cooke regarding the college's recent approval to offer a baccalaureate degree in biomanufacturing.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 3/25/2015 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
UPDATED 2015-04-15 Item 8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2015-04-15 Item 8B - Warrants
8C.
Authorize procurement of seventeen Xerox multi-function printers, award a five-year agreement for managed print services, and approve Resolution 2015-23 adding $97,525 to the Information Technology FY2014/15 Budget. Contact Person: Information Technology Supervisor Labarrere
1) Authorize the City Manager to proceed with the purchase and implementation of 17 Xerox multi-function printers from Technology Integration Group in the amount of $167,202.92 to replace existing end of life and underperforming Canon/Konica Minolta units; 2) Authorize the City Manager to enter into a managed print services contract with Technology Integration Group covering service and supplies for a 60 month term with two optional one- year extensions to ensure adequate equipment uptime and timely fulfillment of consumable (toner/staples) orders for 17 Xerox multi-function printers; and 3) Approve Resolution No. 2015-23 adding $97,525 to the Information Technology FY 2014/15 budget for the purchase of multi-function printers.
2015-04-15 Item 8C - Authorize Procurement Multi-Function Printers
8D.
The preparation and filing of the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District Annual Report. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Ruess
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015-18, directing the preparation and filing of the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District annual report.
2015-04-15 Item 8D - ELLD Annual Report Preparation and Filing
8E.
Authorization for the City Clerk to republish the Encinitas Municipal Code making non-substantive formatting and editorial changes with the objective of creating a code with convenient search capabilities, printing options by either chapter or section, links to cross references and California Government Codes, and a statutory reference table which is updated as statutes are revised. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adopt Resolution 2015-21 authorizing the City Clerk to republish the Encinitas Municipal Code to incorporate Quality Code Publishing's standard editorial procedures to make non-substantive formatting and editorial changes, and changes to department head titles and department names as identified.
2015-04-15 Item 8E - Authorization to Republish the Encinitas Municipal Code
8F.
Legislative Position Letters. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
Approve the legislative position letters for the Mayor's signature.
2015-04-15 Item 8F - Legislative Position Letters
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Parks and Recreation Department Financial Sustainability Project final report. Contact Person: Parks and Recreation Director Rudloff
1) Receive and approve the Plan titled "The City of Encinitas Parks and Recreation Department Financial Sustainability Project"; 2) Authorize staff to implement the Plan recommendations; and 3) Direct the City Manager to report back to the City Council in one year to present a status report on the Plan.
2015-04-15 Item 10A - Financial Sustainability Project
10B.
Street Design Standards. Contact Person: Senior City Engineer Maher
Receive the staff report and direct staff to prepare a Street Design Manual (SDM) based on the Street Design Committee's recommendations and bring back the SDM for City Council consideration and possible approval.
2015-04-15 Item 10B - Street Design Standards
10C.
An overview of the current structure of the City's administrative fines, summary of the fines/penalties applied by other jurisdictions and options available to strengthen our local regulations. Contact Person: Planning and Building Director Murphy
Consider the report and provide staff direction, as deemed appropriate.
2015-04-15 Item 10C - Administrative Fees
10D.
Introduction of City Council Ordinance 2015-06, amending the City Building Code to promote solar photovoltaic and electric vehicle charging systems; and an overview of the City's existing incentives to encourage more energy efficient structures. Contact Person: Planning and Building Director Murphy
1) Consider the changes proposed in the draft ordinance to require increased energy efficiency in new building construction; 2) Introduce City Council Ordinance 2015-06 entitled, "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, amending Sections 23.12.030 and 23.12.035 related to solar energy and electric vehicle ready buildings;" and 3) Receive information on the City's existing incentives to promote energy efficient home improvements.
2015-04-15 Item 10D - Ordinance 2015-06 Green Codes

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
